title: 🛒 Minneapolis Customer Service & Retail Jobs - Multiple Openings - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Minneapolis has a steady flow of front-line jobs right now, especially in retail and property management. If you like helping people face-to-face, these roles are worth a look.
Leasing Specialist – The Cielo Employer: Peak Living Location: Minneapolis, MN Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Work at a growing apartment community, helping people tour, apply for, and renew their homes. This role mixes office work, resident events, and day-to-day problem solving, plus benefits like 3 weeks PTO, paid holidays, 401(k) match, and health coverage .
Plymouth Customer Service Manager (Up to $20/hr) Employer: Chick-fil-A Western Center Blvd (Tide Cleaners franchise) Location: Plymouth, MN (greater Minneapolis area) Type: Full-time Pay: Up to $20/hr Lead the front-of-house team at a bright, modern Tide Cleaners store by Target off 494 and Rockford Rd. Monday–Friday with some Saturdays, focused on building customer relationships, solving issues fast, and managing staff in a clean, non-toxic garment care setting.
Retail Sales Associate, Full Time – Mall of America Employer: Old Navy Location: Mall of America – Minneapolis, MN Type: Full-time Pay: $16.50 – $17.00/hour Front-line role helping shoppers find outfits, join rewards, and check out smoothly in a busy, fun store. Perks include a 50% merchandise discount across Gap brands, PTO , 401(k) with match , stock purchase plan, and access to medical, dental, and vision for eligible employees.
